name: CTU-13 captured-telemetry external application
training_assignment: Window index modulo three chooses one fixed corrupted observation; no label-dependent selection.
objective: Observed-label binary cross-entropy plus Brier, averaged over valid flows within each fixed window. Training windows receive inverse-capture-frequency weights.
early_stopping: Mean validation objective across clean/missing20/spoof20 on capture9, no test access.
threshold: Maximize attack F1 on clean validation capture9; ties choose highest threshold. Fix it for every test condition.
primary: SCR_FLOW minus GMAE macro attack average precision on clean captures10/11/12; higher is better.
bootstrap: 1000 paired crossed training-seed/time-block draws, fixed equal capture weights; resample contiguous64-window blocks within each capture and share draws across models/seeds. Reject jointly any draw without positives in a capture. Primary interval only; secondary descriptive seed intervals.
preprocessing: First six numeric/log features z-scored using observed training values, then clip5; ports scaled65535, binaryflags unchanged. All14 observation masks appended. No IP, absolute timestamp, row/scenario identifier or label field enters numeric features.
graph: Undirected endpoint-sharing graph inside each fixed chronological window, derived from observed source/destination identities; not a prerequisite implication graph. Host identities can recur across splits.
scope: Real captured university traffic with controlled botnet executions, not production incident ground truth. Primary endpoint is retrospective window-end flow classification, not operational COA success. Background/To-only labels excluded, so population is verified-label subset.
stress: Missingness independently masks14featurecoordinates. Spoofing independently replaces20/40percent observed first8numericcoordinates with training-verified-benign means; masks/graph unchanged. These are artificial telemetry manipulations on captured data, not measured adversarial deception.
novelty: Explicit raw-feature adaptations of prior model families. No zero-shot synthetic-to-real transfer, new general architecture, or invented child-parent semantic guarantee is claimed.
communication: No distributed serializer or network-link simulation in this external application; input tensor size and bounded host transfers are measured, not communication compression.
